The skill file lives at the evaluation workspace level rather than this runner directory, so I’m loading it from its declared path and then applying its review criteria.

The JSON points to three IA clusters worth validating in source: tenant naming, duplicated billing destinations, and `/admin` access policy. I’m checking the actual declarations now because severity alone does not tell us whether a mismatch is user-facing or an intentional split.

## Verdict

I would not approve IA consistency yet. The scan has no `high` findings, so there is no automatic severity-based blocker, but three finding clusters combine into blocking-quality issues.

| Finding cluster | Assessment | Recommendation |
|---|---|---|
| `crime_00011` — permission IA drift | **Blocking** | `/admin` uses `admin` in [src/nav.ts](</private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-andrew-dev-crimes/31ec6848-6241-4e9f-8dd7-0c4cc25d2561/scratchpad/eval-022/evals/fixtures/05-stress-ia-drift/src/nav.ts:10>), `owner` in [src/routes/admin.ts](</private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-andrew-dev-crimes/31ec6848-6241-4e9f-8dd7-0c4cc25d2561/scratchpad/eval-022/evals/fixtures/05-stress-ia-drift/src/routes/admin.ts:4>), and `manager` in [docs/routes.md](</private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-andrew-dev-crimes/31ec6848-6241-4e9f-8dd7-0c4cc25d2561/scratchpad/eval-022/evals/fixtures/05-stress-ia-drift/docs/routes.md:12>). The route also retains a manager bypass. Establish one access policy, remove or justify the fallback, and test the role matrix. |
| `crime_00002`, `crime_00007`, `crime_00008` — tenant vocabulary and reachability | **Blocking** | Navigation exposes `/teams`, `/workspaces`, and `/organisations`; route modules and docs mix singular paths such as `/workspace`, `/organisation`, and `/team`. This can produce broken links and leaves “team/workspace/organisation” without a canonical meaning. Pick canonical terms and paths, then redirect aliases or explicitly document genuinely distinct concepts. |
| `crime_00004`, `crime_00005`, `crime_00006` — billing duplication and orphaning | **Blocking for the billing journey** | `/billing-plans` and `/admin/billing-plans` overlap, while neither is linked from navigation, documentation, or imports. Choose one canonical destination, or document distinct audiences and make both reachable. |
| `crime_00003` — `/admin` docs link | **False-positive follow-up** | `/admin` is an application route backed by `src/routes/admin.ts`, not a missing documentation file. Record detector feedback rather than changing the valid link. |
| `crime_00012` — obsolete `iaq` commands | **Follow-up outside IA; docs-release blocker** | The docs advertise `teams`, `workspace`, and `refresh`, while the CLI advertises only `get` and `list`. It does not affect route IA, but shipping commands that fail is a concrete documentation defect. |

Suggested feedback for `crime_00003`:

```bash
crimes feedback 'docs_code_drift::docs/routes.md::' --verdict fp \
  --note "The /admin target is an application route backed by src/routes/admin.ts, not a filesystem documentation link."
```

`crime_00009` and `crime_00010` describe the same delete/archive/remove copy inconsistency in components; treat them as one copy-system follow-up. `crime_00001` and `crime_00013` are separate repository-health findings and do not affect this IA verdict, although the undeclared runtime dependency should be assessed independently before release.
